name: dibsresearch
description: Quarterly comparisons, segment development and an earnings-day brief from companies' own filings, every figure with its source link.

interface.longDescription: dibsresearch gives the model company figures read from the companies' own SEC filings and earnings releases, each with a link to the document and the table cell it came from. The plugin adds three skills on top of the dibsresearch connector: a quarterly comparison of one KPI or statement line across recent quarters or across several companies, the development of business segments over time including changes in how a company reports them, and an earnings-day brief that sets the newest reported quarter against the quarter before and the same quarter a year earlier. Only periods a company reported are shown; a quarter it did not report on its own stays "not reported" and is never computed. Answers contain no share prices, no valuation and no investment advice. A free dibsresearch account is needed to connect.
defaultPrompt: How did NVIDIA's data center revenue develop over the last 8 quarters?
Compare the latest quarterly revenue of Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon.
What did Apple report for its latest quarter versus a year earlier?
